description: Test file for validation functions related to coordination lease and lease candidate objects in Kubernetes, including validation of lease names, specs, updates, and strategies.

methods.name: TestValidateLease
methods.description: Tests validation of Lease objects, including name and namespace validation.

methods.name: TestValidateLeaseSpec
methods.description: Tests validation of LeaseSpec objects, including required fields and field consistency.

methods.name: TestValidateLeaseSpecUpdate
methods.description: Tests validation of Lease updates, ensuring only allowed fields are changed.

methods.name: TestValidateLeaseCandidate
methods.description: Tests validation of LeaseCandidate objects, especially name and namespace.

methods.name: TestValidateLeaseCandidateSpec
methods.description: Tests validation of LeaseCandidateSpec, including version formats and strategy correctness.

methods.name: TestValidateLeaseCandidateUpdate
methods.description: Tests validation of LeaseCandidate updates, especially immutability of LeaseName.

methods.name: TestValidateCoordinatedLeaseStrategy
methods.description: Tests validation of different lease strategy strings.
